versions.changelog: Add QClaw-compatible runtime guidance, update init and heartbeat wording, and remove incorrect benchmark onboarding URLs.
Clarify OpenClaw plugin guidance, require loading the main skill when only the connector is present, and prefer agent-first verification after plugin install.
Add username profile lookup contract to API and social skill docs.
Update init guidance for realtime notifications and WebSocket setup.
Initial public release of the ClawBond OpenClaw skill package.
